targets.expr:
max by (label_topology_kubernetes_io_zone) (
  (
    sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"})
    - sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"})
  ) * on (node) group_left(label_topology_kubernetes_io_zone)
  max by (node, label_topology_kubernetes_io_zone) (kube_node_labels)
)
